isitan-sfc-350-vx.name: SFC 350-VX — semi-automatic circular cold saw
isitan-sfc-350-vx.summary: A semi-automatic cold saw for short batch runs: foot-switch actuation, hydro-pneumatic head descent with a cutting-speed regulator and head stroke set to the material, so the operator loads and the saw cuts. Heavy-duty double gearbox, cast-iron base, two blade speeds and mitre cuts 45° each way — Ø4-1/2″ round and 3-7/8″ square mild steel on a 13-3/4″ HSS blade, burr-free and ready to weld.
features: Semi-automatic cycle: foot-switch actuation, hydro-pneumatic head descent with cutting-speed regulator; head stroke adjustable to material size
Heavy-duty double gearbox; cast-iron base; two blade speeds 45 / 80 rpm
Mitre cuts 45° right to 45° left; self-centering double split vise grips both sides of the material
Wet-type cold sawing for clean, burr-free cuts; coolant pump and tank
24 V control voltage; CSA-approved panel; air supply 85 psi (8.5 cfm)
optional: Saw blades for specific materials — TiN for medium-hard steel, TiCN for high-strength steel, TiAlN for stainless
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a main motor of 2.2 kW (3 HP) or less

specs.note: Cutting capacities are for mild steel at 90° and 45°. Wet-type cold sawing with the standard coolant pump; TiN, TiCN and TiAlN-coated HSS blades are available for medium-hard, high-strength and stainless steel. Air supply for the SFC 350-VX: 85 psi, 8.5 cfm.

isitan-sfc-350-vx.headline: 13-3/4″ blade · Ø4-1/2″ round · semi-automatic, 45 / 80 rpm

isitan-sfc-v.name: SFC 275 / 315-VP · SFC 275 / 315-V — circular cold saws with pneumatic or manual vise
isitan-sfc-v.summary: Pull-down circular cold saws with a 10-3/4″ or 12-1/2″ blade, two speeds and mitre cuts 45° left and right: the VP models clamp with an air-operated vise, the V models with a manual vise. Low-voltage start/stop trigger in the handle, a robust double-hinged pivot, a double split vise that grips both sides of the cut and a large base for stability — the metal cutting saw for tube, bar and profile in the fabrication shop, with a clean, burr-free cut the band saw cannot match.
features: SFC VP: air-operated material vise; SFC V: manually operated vise
Low-voltage start/stop trigger in the pull-down handle; robust double-hinged pivot
Mitre cuts 45° left and right; double split vise grips both sides of the material; self-centering vise optimizes the cutting position
Two blade speeds 45 / 90 rpm; wet-type cold sawing for burr-free cuts; coolant pump and tank
Large base for stability; 24 V control voltage; CSA-approved panel
optional: Saw blades for specific materials — TiN for medium-hard steel, TiCN for high-strength steel, TiAlN for stainless
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a main motor of 2.2 kW (3 HP) or less

specs.note: Cutting capacities are for mild steel at 90° and 45°. Wet-type cold sawing with the standard coolant pump; TiN, TiCN and TiAlN-coated HSS blades are available for medium-hard, high-strength and stainless steel.

isitan-sfc-v.headline: 10-3/4″ and 12-1/2″ blades · Ø3-3/8″ and Ø4-1/8″ round · pneumatic or manual vise

tt-cs.name: CS cold saws, 9 – 14″ blade, cut Ø2-3/8 – 4-3/4″
tt-cs.summary: Gear-driven cold saws for clean, burr-free cuts in tube, bar and profiles. The CS-225, CS-250 and CS-275 run a 9 – 11″ blade at 42 – 46 rpm through a gearbox in an oil bath, with a 24 V hold-to-run control and a vise with an anti-burr device, and swivel 45° left and right; the CS-315 and CS-350 on stands take 12-1/2 and 14″ blades, cut Ø3-7/8 and 4-3/4″ round, run at two speeds (18 / 36 rpm) and clamp in a quick-adjusting double vise.
features: Round capacity at 90°: Ø2-3/8″ (CS-225, CS-250) to Ø4-3/4″ (CS-350); rectangular to 5-1/2 × 3-7/8″
Head swivels 45° left and right; angle cuts at 45° to Ø4-1/8″
Gear drive; reduction unit in an oil bath (CS-225 – 275); two blade speeds (CS-315, 350)
24 V low-voltage hold-to-run control; vise with anti-burr device; double vise on the CS-315 and 350
CS-315 / 350: 1 / 1.7 HP two-speed 3-phase or 1.5 HP single-phase motor

csm-ct325.name: CT325 hydraulic circular saws with servo feed, Ø1/2″ to Ø4″ tube and bundles
csm-ct325.summary: The automatic circular saw CSM builds for its bending cells: hydraulic down-feed of a Ø10 – 12-3/4″ blade driven through planetary gears, hydraulic clamping, a servo carriage that feeds the tube to ±0.004″ and a PLC with touch-screen — round, square, rectangular and angle sections, single or in bundles with the customised vises. Three spindle-speed ranges for steel (L), stainless and alloy (M) and aluminum and non-ferrous (H), all at 3.8 HP.

bekamak-bmdo-xs.name: BMDO 75XS · 100XS · 130XS · 150XS — automatic TCT carbide circular saws, Ø3-1/8″ to Ø6-1/4″
bekamak-bmdo-xs.summary: High-speed carbide cold saws for mass production of cut-off pieces from solid steel and non-ferrous bar: a TCT circular blade at 130 – 920 ft/min, a servo saw-head feed and a servo material feed with a 31-1/2″ stroke, a hydraulic vise with top clamping, micro-spray lubrication and a 20 ft magazine loader. Load a bundle of bars, program the lengths and quantities on the control and the saw cuts unattended, to ±.004″, from Ø3-1/8″ bar on the BMDO 75XS up to Ø6-1/4″ on the BMDO 150XS. HSS blades fit the same machines for tube.
features: TCT carbide circular blades Ø11-1/4″ to Ø18-1/8″ for high-speed cutting of solid bar; HSS blades for tube
Servo saw-head feed and AC-servo ball-screw material feed, 31-1/2″ (800 mm) stroke, lengths 3/8″ to 394″ — cuts to ±.004″
Hydraulic vise and hydraulic top clamping; heavy-duty gearbox; inverter-driven blade speed 130 – 655 ft/min (920 on the 75XS)
20 ft (6 m) magazine loader for 6 to 17 bars; chip conveyor; ILC micro-spray coolant; blade brush; cover safety switch
Options: 20 ft (6 m) material roller table, air filter

bekamak-bmdo-cs.name: BMDO 80CS · 100CS — automatic HSS circular saws, Ø3-1/8″ and Ø4″
bekamak-bmdo-cs.summary: Automatic HSS cold saws for tube and bar up to Ø4″: a vertical-slide saw head with a cemented and ground helical-gear drive for a vibration-free cut, an inverter for stepless blade speed and electric servo feeding with a flexible gripper and floating carriage that holds ±.002 – .004″ per stroke even in bar that is not perfectly straight. Several cutting lengths per bar are programmed on the touch screen; safety covers enclose the cut.
features: HSS circular blades Ø10-1/4″ to 14-1/8″; tube and solid bar Ø3/4″ to 3-1/8″ (80CS) or 4″ (100CS)
Vertical-slide saw head for rigidity; helical-gear head without worm screw — no play or vibration at the blade
Electric servo feeding with flexible gripper and floating carriage: ±.002 – .004″ (0.05 – 0.1 mm) per stroke; 19-3/4″ or 39-3/8″ feed stroke
Touch-screen control with several cutting lengths per bar; inverter blade speed 72 – 425 ft/min
Hydraulic vise, heavy-duty gearbox, blade brush, chip conveyor, safety covers and switch
Options: micro-spray coolant, 20 ft (6 m) feed roller table

bekamak-opus-300.name: OPUS 300 — automatic TCT carbide circular saw, Ø11-3/4″
bekamak-opus-300.summary: The largest of Bekamak's carbide cold saws: a Ø35-7/16″ (900 mm) TCT blade on a 50 HP (37 kW) spindle and a servo-driven saw head cut solid steel and non-ferrous bar from Ø2-3/4″ to Ø11-3/4″ (70 – 300 mm) in continuous production. The AC-servo ball-screw material feed positions the bar in a 27-1/2″ (700 mm) stroke to lengths from 3/8″ to 394″, the 20 ft (6 m) automatic loader holds five Ø11-3/4″ bars, and the enclosed cabin, hydraulic clamping, oil-mist lubrication and chip conveyor let the saw run unattended, down to a 3-3/8″ (85 mm) remnant.

50 HP (37 kW) main motor, blade speed 165 – 785 ft/min (50 – 240 m/min); 5.4 HP (4 kW) servo saw-head feed
AC-servo ball-screw material feed: 27-1/2″ (700 mm) stroke, lengths 3/8″ – 394″ (10 – 9999 mm) at up to 30 in/s; 3/8″ end trim, 3-3/8″ remnant
20 ft (6 m) automatic magazine loader for five Ø11-3/4″ bars; hydraulic clamping; enclosed cabin with chip conveyor and oil-mist lubrication
Options: air filter, 20 ft (6 m) automatic material stand
